decision_rules: Primary functional control gate: all three impaired controls have lower log odds than retained D882N, per weight/backbone. Expanded gate includes K795A and D882A. Retain all failures.
Candidate ranks use 17 N-to-K domain sites including itself. Background fractions are descriptive, not p-values or clinical labels.
Failure of controls restricts structural likelihood to description; successful separation is still narrow and cannot establish N1002K function.
No drug, phase, clinical-margin or wet-lab promotion; stop codon and NMD are outside this protein model.
limitations: Four weight sets are related, not four independent models. Six predicted WT structures and decoding orders are not biological replicates.
Predicted isolated domain omits cellular partners, dynamics and full-length regulation.
Training overlap is unresolved. Conditional log odds are not measured stability or function.
